answer.summary: Docker build fails in the front-builder stage because of a JSX syntax error in openaev-front/src/admin/components/graph/Graph.tsx (around line 290): an unclosed Box tag and an unexpected token. The change touches this file, so rerunning will fail the same way.

evidence.quote: #15 33.13 [builtin:vite-transform] Expected corresponding JSX closing tag for 'Box'.
#15 33.13 [builtin:vite-transform] Unexpected token. Did you mean `{'}'}` or `}`?

#15 ERROR: process "/bin/sh -c set -eux                             ; npm install -g corepack                  ; yarn install                             ; yarn build                               ;" did not complete successfully: exit code: 1
